annotations.title: Find alcohol treatment programs that prescribe medication

description: Programs that report to SAMHSA FindTreatment.gov that they prescribe or give medication for alcohol use disorder, near a ZIP code (closest first, straight-line miles) or in a state or city. Each result: name, address or city, phone, which of the four approved medications it reports (naltrexone pill, monthly naltrexone shot, acamprosate, disulfiram), setting, telehealth, payment accepted, an id for get_facility and its alcohol.help page. Filters for medication, setting and payment.

city.description: City within state, e.g. "Columbus". Needs state.

limit.description: Results per page (1 to 10); page further with offset.

medication.description: Only programs that report using this FDA-approved alcohol use disorder medication. naltrexone_shot = monthly extended-release injection (Vivitrol).

payment.description: Only programs that report accepting this payment. "medicaid" means some Medicaid plans; ask about a specific plan by name.

setting.description: Only programs that report this care setting.

state.description: Two-letter state code, e.g. OH, when searching a state or city instead of a ZIP.

zip.description: Five-digit US ZIP code, e.g. 85004. Give this, or state.
